recent_excerpts: Unit 42's OperTraitor scanned OperatorHub and found IBM Turbonomic granting cluster-wide secret access, tied to CVE-2026-6389 (CVSS 8.8) in the operator's RBAC design.
SentinelLabs uncovers PCPJack, a credential-stealing worm targeting Docker, Kubernetes, Redis, and MongoDB that actively removes rival TeamPCP access from compromised cloud...
